These FloPlast uPVC square fascia brackets provide a reliable and secure method for attaching guttering to fascia boards. They are an essential component for effective roofline drainage systems, suitable for both new construction projects and refurbishment applications on various properties. The robust black uPVC construction ensures durability and long-lasting performance in various weather conditions. Designed for 114mm square gutters, these brackets are a compatible solution with most major guttering manufacturers for comprehensive rainwater management.
